title: What a material is
misconception: 1A-M1: thinks an object (a hoe, a pot) is a material
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: Look at things at home and on the farm. For each one, you can ask: what is it made of?
Take a hoe. The hoe is the object. It is the thing you use.
The blade is made of metal. The handle is made of wood. These are the materials.
So the object is the whole thing.

pages.board: material: what it is made of
pages.say: The material is the stuff the thing is made of.
A basket is an object. It is made of cane.
A cooking pot is an object. It is often made of aluminium, a metal.

pages.board: A hoe is not a material
pages.say: So a hoe is not a material. A pot is not a material. They are objects made from materials.
Now it is your turn. Think about what each thing is made of.
